materialize.claim: The median of the CLOSE of the 1-minute BTC-USD candle ending 2026-11-07T15:00:00Z on Coinbase, Bitstamp and Kraken is at least (>=) 75900 USD.

elements.q: Is the median close of the 1-minute BTC-USD candle ending 2026-11-07T15:00:00Z on Coinbase, Bitstamp and Kraken at least (>=) 75900 USD?

custom_definitions: Fallback: if one named source is unavailable the remaining sources must confirm; if too few can be checked the outcome is VOID with full refunds after the recovery window.
The CLOSE of the 1-minute candle is what is checked, never the high (wick). With three venues the median close decides; with two the mean, and VOID if they straddle the level; fewer than two is VOID.
Early resolution: never before the candle has closed; the settle request is T + 5 minutes.
Only the BTC-USD pair on the three named venues is eligible; no aggregators or other assets.

materialize.claim: BTC-USD 1-minute candle high is at or above 76000 USD on at least two of Coinbase, Bitstamp, Kraken between 2026-11-07T12:00:00Z and 2026-12-07T12:00:00Z.

elements.q: Is a 1-minute BTC-USD candle high >= 76000 on at least two of Coinbase, Bitstamp and Kraken between 2026-11-07T12:00:00Z and 2026-12-07T12:00:00Z?

custom_definitions: Fallback: if one named source is unavailable the remaining sources must confirm; if too few can be checked the outcome is VOID with full refunds after the recovery window.
A 1-minute candle HIGH (the wick), not the close, crossing the stated USD level counts as a touch; the touch requires confirmation on at least two of the three named venues.
Early YES resolution is allowed at the first qualifying confirmed candle, never before; if no touch occurred in the window the outcome is NO.
Only the BTC-USD pair on the three named venues is eligible; no aggregators or other assets.

custom_definitions: Fallback: if one named source is unavailable the remaining sources must confirm; if too few can be checked the outcome is VOID with full refunds after the recovery window.

custom_definitions: Fallback: if one named source is unavailable the remaining sources must confirm; if too few can be checked the outcome is VOID with full refunds after the recovery window.
Early resolution: only once the CLI report for the climate day is published; never before. Both the NWS CLI and the IEM copy must give the same maximum; a missing (MM) or differing maximum is VOID.
The climate day is local standard time all year (no daylight saving adjustment), not the UTC day.
